<!-- generated by npm run docs:generate; do not edit -->

Admin routes of the campaigns module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/campaigns

List marketing campaigns

Parameters:

- `kind` in query (`"BROADCAST"`, `"WINBACK"`, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `status` in query (`"DRAFT"`, `"SCHEDULED"`, `"SENDING"`, `"SENT"`, `"CANCELLED"`, `"FAILED"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Campaigns retrieved.

## POST /v1/admin/campaigns

Create a marketing campaign

Request body: [CreateCampaignDto](#createcampaigndto).

Responses:

- `201`: Created.
- `400`: Invalid input / invalid coupon.

## DELETE /v1/admin/campaigns/{id}

Soft-delete a campaign

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Deleted.
- `404`: Campaign not found.

## GET /v1/admin/campaigns/{id}

Get a campaign

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Campaign retrieved.
- `404`: Campaign not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/campaigns/{id}

Update a draft / scheduled campaign

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateCampaignDto](#updatecampaigndto).

Responses:

- `200`: Updated.
- `400`: Invalid input / invalid coupon.
- `404`: Campaign not found.
- `409`: Campaign is not editable.

## POST /v1/admin/campaigns/{id}/preview

Render a draft campaign for every enabled locale (no send, no persist)

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [PreviewCampaignDto](#previewcampaigndto).

Responses:

- `200`: Rendered preview.
- `404`: Campaign not found.

## POST /v1/admin/campaigns/{id}/send

Send / start a campaign on the isolated campaign queue

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Sending started.
- `404`: Campaign not found.
- `409`: Campaign is not sendable.

## GET /v1/admin/campaigns/{id}/stats

Per-status send counts for a campaign

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Stats retrieved.

## POST /v1/admin/campaigns/{id}/test

Send a test of this campaign to your own inbox

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [SendTestCampaignDto](#sendtestcampaigndto).

Responses:

- `200`: Test sent.
- `400`: No recipient email on file.
- `404`: Campaign not found.

## Schemas

### CampaignTranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, optional).

### CreateCampaignDto

- `name` (string, min length 1, max length 200, required).
- `subject` ([CampaignTranslatableDto](#campaigntranslatabledto), required).
- `body` ([CampaignTranslatableDto](#campaigntranslatabledto), required).
- `segment` (`"ALL_CONFIRMED"`, `"NEW"`, `"ACTIVE"`, `"LOYAL"`, `"AT_RISK"`, `"CHURNED"`, `"LAPSED"`, required).
- `couponCode` (string, max length 100, nullable, optional).
- `scheduledAt` (string, nullable, optional).

### PreviewCampaignDto

- `subject` ([CampaignTranslatableDto](#campaigntranslatabledto), optional).
- `body` ([CampaignTranslatableDto](#campaigntranslatabledto), optional).
- `sampleVariables` (object, optional).

### SendTestCampaignDto

- `locale` (`"fr"`, `"en"`, `"ar"`, optional).

### UpdateCampaignDto

- `name` (string, min length 1, max length 200, optional).
- `subject` ([CampaignTranslatableDto](#campaigntranslatabledto), optional).
- `body` ([CampaignTranslatableDto](#campaigntranslatabledto), optional).
- `segment` (`"ALL_CONFIRMED"`, `"NEW"`, `"ACTIVE"`, `"LOYAL"`, `"AT_RISK"`, `"CHURNED"`, `"LAPSED"`, optional).
- `couponCode` (string, max length 100, nullable, optional).
- `scheduledAt` (string, nullable, optional).
